sections.title: Core Foundations & Conceptual Framework
sections.content:
• **Foundational Principle 1**: The Commission was chaired by **Sir Anthony MacDonnell** to review the efficacy of the **Famine Codes** established after the 1880 Famine Commission.
• **Foundational Principle 2**: It emphasized the **'Moral Obligation'** of the State to provide relief, shifting from a purely laissez-faire approach to state-managed intervention.
• **Foundational Principle 3**: It advocated for the **'Protective Irrigation'** works and the creation of a **'Famine Insurance Fund'** to mitigate future risks.
• **Key Metric / Factor**: The commission recommended the appointment of a **'Famine Commissioner'** in every province to ensure proactive monitoring of crop failure and price spikes.

sections.title: Comprehensive Classification & Comparative Matrix
rows: Emphasis on 'Village Works' over large camps
Decentralized relief to prevent mass migration
Prelims: Shift from centralized to decentralized relief

items.definition: Standardized administrative manuals detailing the procedures for declaring a famine and the scale of relief to be provided; MacDonnell refined these to be more flexible.
Irrigation projects designed specifically to prevent famine in drought-prone areas, rather than purely for commercial crop yield.

items.title: Major Applications / Initiatives
items.content:
• **Key Application 1**: Expansion of the Famine Insurance Fund to provide financial cushion.
• **Key Application 2**: Strengthening of the 'Agricultural Banks' to provide credit to farmers, reducing dependence on moneylenders.

items.title: Challenges & Way Forward
items.content:
• **Key Challenges**: The policy remained focused on 'relief' rather than addressing the structural causes like high taxation and commercialization of agriculture.
• **Solutions**: Shift toward land reform and irrigation infrastructure as suggested by later commissions.

items.title: Mnemonic for Retention
items.content:
• **Memory Acronym / Phrase**: 'MAC-1900-CURZON'
• **Decoded Meaning**: MAC (MacDonnell Commission) - 1900 (Year) - CURZON (Viceroy who appointed it).

upscNotes.content: Examiner Trap: UPSC often confuses the 1880 Famine Commission (Strachey) with the 1900 Commission (MacDonnell). Remember: Strachey = First Famine Code; MacDonnell = Refinement/Review of Famine Code.
Mains Value Addition: Use the term 'Administrative Paternalism' to describe the British approach to famine relief post-1900.

keyTakeaways: The MacDonnell Commission marked the transition from reactive relief to proactive administrative management.
It emphasized the necessity of protective irrigation and decentralized relief works.
It was a direct response to the catastrophic famine of 1899-1900 under Lord Curzon.
